interpretation: With the configured 2000 validation / 2001 save cadence, this Lightning version saves step-2001 weights using the score from step-2000 validation. A 2000-step cadence checks before the validation metric is available and saves nothing in this minimal setup. Validation-end saving aligns checkpoint step and score in the synthetic test.
